description: Add Agent Syncing to Profile Sync Pipeline — Allow profiles to declare agents in baton.profile.yaml, merge them across inheritance chains with last-wins semantics, and place agent files to all configured AI tools during baton sync

userStories.title: Add agents field to profile manifest schema
userStories.description: As a profile author, I want to declare agents in my baton.profile.yaml so they are synced to developers' AI tools.
acceptanceCriteria: In packages/core/src/schemas/profile-manifest.ts, define a private agentsSchema using the same z.union pattern as rulesSchema: z.union([z.array(z.string()), z.record(z.string(), z.array(z.string()).optional())])
Add agents: agentsSchema.optional() to aiSectionSchema alongside the existing rules field
Array format validates: agents: ['code-reviewer', 'test-writer'] (universal, synced to all tools)
Object format validates: agents: { universal: ['shared'], 'claude-code': ['claude-only'] } (tool-specific targeting)
Empty arrays and missing field validate correctly
Invalid input (non-string arrays, nested objects) is rejected by schema
Unit tests in a co-located test file covering: valid array format, valid object format, mixed keys, empty array, missing field, invalid input
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: The pattern to mirror is rulesSchema at profile-manifest.ts lines 34-39 (private, z.union of z.array(z.string()) and z.record). aiSectionSchema is at lines 70-79 — add agents alongside rules (line 75). Neither rulesSchema nor aiSectionSchema are exported; ProfileManifest (line 136) is the public type and will automatically include the new field via z.infer. No separate AgentItem type export is needed — the rules pattern doesn't export one either. The test file should be co-located: profile-manifest.test.ts. Test using profileManifestSchema.safeParse() with manifests containing ai.agents in both formats.

userStories.title: Create mergeAgents() merge function
userStories.description: As a developer using multiple profiles, I want agent conflicts resolved predictably so I know which profile's agent definition wins.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/core/src/merge/agents.ts implements mergeAgents() and mergeAgentsWithWarnings()
AgentEntry interface has: name (string), agents (string[] — empty = universal), profileName (string) — mirrors RuleEntry exactly
MergeAgentsResult interface has: agents (AgentEntry[]), warnings (WeightConflictWarning[])
Merge key format: 'universal:agentName' for array-format, 'agentKey:agentName' for object-format (mirroring rules)
Last-wins semantics: later profiles in weight-sorted array override earlier entries for the same key
Weight -1 locking: locked agents (isLockedProfile) cannot be overridden by subsequent profiles
Same-weight conflict warnings emitted with category 'agent' when two profiles define the same key at the same weight
WeightConflictWarning category type in packages/core/src/merge/weight-sort.ts updated to include 'agent'
mergeAgents, mergeAgentsWithWarnings, AgentEntry, MergeAgentsResult exported from packages/core/src/index.ts

Unit tests in packages/core/src/merge/agents.test.ts covering: single profile array, single profile object, multiple profiles last-wins, universal vs tool-specific, weight ordering, weight locking, same-weight warnings, empty agents
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Mirror packages/core/src/merge/rules.ts exactly (134 lines). Import ResolvedProfile from ../inheritance/profile-chain.js, getProfileWeight + isLockedProfile + WeightConflictWarning from ./weight-sort.js. Access profile data via profile.manifest.ai?.agents (available after US-001). Key difference from rules: field name is 'agents' not 'rules' in profile.manifest.ai, category is 'agent' not 'rule' in warnings, result property is 'agents' not 'rules'. WeightConflictWarning.category at weight-sort.ts line 49 currently has: 'skill' | 'rule' | 'memory' | 'command' | 'file' | 'ide' — add | 'agent'. Export block in core/index.ts should mirror the rules export block at lines 224-230.

userStories.title: Add agent processing to sync pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer running baton sync, I want agent files placed alongside rules, skills, and memory so my AI tools can use custom agents.
acceptanceCriteria: In packages/cli/src/commands/sync.ts, call mergeAgentsWithWarnings(weightSortedProfiles) during the merge phase (after rules merge at line 422)
Push agent warnings to allWeightWarnings array
Add agent count to the merged spinner.stop message at line 534
Update content accumulator type union from 'memory' | 'rules' to 'memory' | 'rules' | 'agents' at line 728
Add agent accumulation loop between the rules accumulation (ends line 955) and the content flush (starts line 957), mirroring the rules loop structure
For each adapter, filter agents: universal (agents.length === 0) apply to all, tool-specific only when agents.includes(adapter.key)
Agent source files resolved from {profileDir}/ai/agents/universal/{name}.md (universal) or {profileDir}/ai/agents/{agentKey}/{name}.md (tool-specific) — same subdirectory pattern as rules
Parse agent files with parseFrontmatter(), build AgentFile with required frontmatter (default to { name: agentEntry.name } if no frontmatter found)
Call adapter.transformAgent(agentFile) before accumulating
Accumulate transformed content into contentAccumulator with type 'agents'
Update content flush comment at line 957 from 'memory+rules' to 'memory+rules+agents'
Add agents count to dry-run summary at lines 1201-1204
Add verbose logging for agent processing
Import mergeAgentsWithWarnings and AgentEntry from @baton-dx/core (add to existing import block at lines 3-41)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: AgentFile.frontmatter is REQUIRED (not optional like RuleFile.frontmatter). When building AgentFile from parsed source, always provide frontmatter — use { name: agentEntry.name } as fallback when no YAML frontmatter exists. AgentFile also has optional 'description' at top level — populate from frontmatter.description if available. The rules accumulation loop (lines 873-955) is the exact template to copy: same filter pattern (isUniversal/isForThisAdapter), same source file resolution (resolve profileDir + 'ai' + 'agents' + subdir + name.md), same content accumulator pattern. The flush at lines 957-997 already handles any type in the accumulator — it calls placeFile(content, adapter, entry.type, 'project', entry.name, config), and adapters support 'agents' as a configType. Lockfile tracking and orphan cleanup are automatic through the flush. Gitignore already covers agent paths (collectComprehensivePatterns calls adapter.getPath('agents', 'project', '_probe') — no changes needed). Must run 'bun run build' before 'bun run typecheck' since CLI resolves @baton-dx/core from dist/. Import AgentFile type: add 'type AgentFile' to the existing @baton-dx/core import block (line 3-41). Also import type AgentEntry.
